title: Payments
subtitle: Stripe test-mode payment links, driven by webhooks. Collected revenue counts only money received.

form.title: New payment link
form.hint: Billed through Stripe in test mode. A PKR value is converted for the test account and the original value stays visible.

createFailed: Could not create the payment link.

success.title: Payment received
success.body: Thank you. Your payment was received and the team has been notified.

cancelled.title: Payment not completed
cancelled.body: No payment was taken. You can use the same link again while it is valid.
